steps.name: a guest reaches the feed and private activity returns to sign-in with the original target
a first-time visitor signs in with a real emailed code and gets a server session
a wrong code is refused and the account stays signed out
shortlisting two real providers persists in that workspace and renders in Compare
saving a Look is private and durable in the database
a second signed-in account cannot read the first account plan or saves
an unauthenticated request with a stolen cookie string cannot forge a session
revoking the session row in the database signs the live browser out
signing out ends the server session for the other account
an administrator sets up a real second factor and clears the server review queue
a signed-in client without an administrator grant is refused the admin console by the server
a real applicant submits provider and salon workspaces, an administrator approves them, and the applicant switches into the granted workspace
the signed-in shell shows no client-side errors across the tested journeys
